messages:
elena: Quick async standup for prelaunch lab work — what I did / blockers / today

elena: What I did: merged kv-cache fix into staging, ran perf sweep on 4k seqs, pushed patch to routing logic (PR #482). Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference/pull/482

elena: Blockers: noticed ~8% p99 increase on long sequences after the patch. Haven't pinned root cause — might be kernel selection fallback. Also flaky unit `batcher_test::test_prefix_cache` failing locally.

elena: Today: triage perf with sampling traces, run full test matrix on dedicated-ci, and address the flaky test if repro. Will ping for reviews on any hotfixes. :rocket:

sam: Thanks — saw the PR. Can you drop the perf trace link? I'll look at kernel selection heuristics this morning.

elena: https://ci.internal.redwood/trace/1768512345/perf-compare — filter `seq_len>2048` and sort by p99.

kevin: I can take the flaky test. If it's timing-related we should add a deterministic clock helper rather than a sleep. Assigning to myself.

anya: Quick prioritization question from PM: do we gate launch on the p99 regression or do we ship with rollback + canary thresholds? Matt, any preference?

matt: Product POV: prefer canary + automated rollback if we can detect regressions in checkout region. Gate only if we see functional breakages.

zara: QA note: I ran the end-to-end lab suite on Friday — found one data race in session teardown (logs attached). Will run another pass after the hotfix.

elena: Good call. Sam, can you check the kernel route where we fallback to fp16 path? I suspect the sequence length heuristic flips too early.

sam: On it. Also adding a temporary metric `kernel_fallback_rate` to the dashboard so we can monitor during canary.

kevin: Re: flaky test — I have a small PR that replaces sleeps with `TestClock::advance` and stabilizes timing. Will link in a sec. PR #489.

deploy-bot: deploy 1768514800 to staging started by elena — smoke tests queued.

elena: thx kevin — will review PR #489. Zara — thanks for the race logs, can you paste the stack trace in the thread?

zara: stack: `inference::session::teardown -> runtime::gpu::destroy_kv -> cudaStreamSynchronize` — looks like teardown finishes before async flush.

elena: noted. Plan: 1) kevin's test fix merged 2) sam to add fallback metric + triage kernel heuristics 3) I run perf traces and if p99 stays high after hotfix -> hold canary and escalate. Otherwise proceed with canary + rollback thresholds per Matt.

matt: Sounds good. If you need an emergency decision, ping me with the canary metric snapshot.

sam: Quick heads up — I might need a 30m pairing with elena to step through the trace. Putting a calendar ping.

elena: cool. I'll be available at 10:30 PT. Otherwise I'll post updates here. :thumbsup:
